Principal AI & GenAI Architect | AI Platform Engineering | Agentic AI | Azure AI | Enterprise Architecture | Python | .NET

Principal AI & GenAI Architect with 20+ years of enterprise software engineering and architecture experience, including 7+ years delivering AI, GenAI and intelligent automation solutions. Experienced in designing enterprise AI platforms, LLM-powered applications, RAG architectures, agentic workflows, cloud-native microservices, and AI governance on Azure and AWS. Strong background in Python and .NET, enterprise integration, distributed systems, and modernization across Healthcare, Banking, Insurance, Retail and Financial Services. Known for leading architecture strategy, mentoring engineering teams, driving AI adoption, and delivering scalable, secure, production-grade AI solutions.
AI & GenAI: Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, LLMs, RAG, Prompt Engineering, AI Agents, Multi-Agent Systems, AI Guardrails, AI Governance
• AI Platform Engineering: LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, MCP, AI Orchestration, Vector Search, Embeddings
• Cloud: Azure AI, AWS (Amazon Bedrock, Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, SQS), AKS, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Event Grid, API Management, Logic Apps
• Architecture: Enterprise Architecture, Domain-Driven Design, Event-Driven Architecture, Microservices, API-first
• Engineering: Python, C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, REST APIs
• Enterprise Integration: SAP, Salesforce, Power Platform, RPA (UiPath, Automation Anywhere) as AI enablement
